title: Saving, Continue and Steam Cloud - House of Pips Wiki
description: How House of Pips saves your match and career, how CONTINUE works, Save and exit, Rage quit, Steam Cloud conflicts and Clean Slate.
html:
Saving, Continue and Steam Cloud

Your career saves itself #

Your career (level, skills, Bone Bucks, unlocks, supplies, cosmetics and records) is saved on your computer as you play. There is no manual save.

Matches save automatically #

An unfinished match is saved whenever the table settles after a change, and closing the window keeps it. Next time, CONTINUE on the main menu takes you back exactly where you left the table.

If you close the game in the middle of a play or on a hand summary, CONTINUE returns you to the table just before that play. Anything the play already earned (XP, Bone Bucks, records) stays in your career, and playing it again doesn't pay it twice.

Puzzles are the exception: an unfinished puzzle starts over when you return to it.

Leaving a match #

Open Settings during a match for two ways out:

  • Save and exit keeps the match and returns to the menu. It isn't offered during cutscenes.
  • Rage quit forfeits the match (and flips the table): it counts as a loss, and you get no match reward.

A friend's multiplayer invitation also offers Save and join when the table or draft is ready to save. It saves the solo match before entering the lobby, so Continue can resume it after multiplayer. If saving fails, the game keeps your live match and does not join. See Online play.

Anything that would throw away the current match first asks Abandon round? Choose Keep playing to back out with the table exactly as it was.

Steam Cloud #

With Steam Cloud on, your career, unlocks, cosmetics, achievement progress, online skill build and saved solo match follow you to other computers and Steam Deck. Display, audio and controller settings stay on each device.

  • A saved match only travels to another computer after you leave it with Save and exit.
  • Let Steam finish syncing before you switch computers.
  • If the two copies disagree, the game asks you to choose which progress to keep: Keep this device, Use Steam Cloud, or Decide later and keep playing on this device. Each card shows its level, Prestige rank, wins and losses, playtime, last played date and saved match, so you can tell them apart.
  • The copy you choose replaces the other one, and that can't be undone. Read both cards before you choose.
  • The Steam Cloud button in the Settings header shows the current sync status.

Clean Slate #

Clean Slate, in Settings outside a match, permanently erases your career, progress and preferences, including the Steam Cloud copy. It is not a troubleshooting step. Achievements already unlocked on Steam stay unlocked. Choose Keep my account if you opened it by mistake.

The demo #

The demo saves separately from the full game, doesn't use Steam Cloud, and doesn't carry its career over to the full game.

Steam Playtest #

Steam Playtest uses the full game's local career and saves, so progress on this device is shared. Steam Cloud is not enabled for the Playtest.
